# pvecli cluster health

Quorum, node votes, HA and Ceph state in one view.

```text
pvecli cluster health [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
